scope: bounded static implementation review; no model forward or optimizer replay

checks.fresh_communication_only: restore loads v28 private_all checkpoints, discards private heads, and resets only communication modules
checks.frozen_visual_inputs: all inherited train/test caches are detached float32 arrays and are bound by input hashes
checks.paired_support_fixture: two arms share seven map/photo/mask worlds per base draw and differ only in the five arm-specific maps
checks.multi_partner_target: target12 is a 2-regular graph with two partners per food and water location
checks.no_training_shortcut: partner-pair and recombination metrics are computed offline from saved endpoint arrays
checks.formal_gate: formal execution binds both source_hashes and input_hashes to preflight_qa
checks.fixed_budget: all formal runs use 2400 updates, 240 messages per direction, and no performance-based selection

limitations: The inherited DINOv2-L and private checkpoints are verified by hashes rather than retrained in this batch.
The bounded audit samples fixture and categorical replay points; it does not replay every gradient or Adam state transition.
The support contrast changes a joint graph topology; it does not by itself identify a unique causal role for path count.
